title: Lake Hawkins RV Park

services.name: Day Use
services.desc: Come enjoy one of the most incredible white-sand beaches and some of the clearest water in the Pineywoods of Northeast Texas at beautiful Lake Hawkins. No need to call and reserve a day pass. Just show up and pay at check-in window. Might wanna bring a canopy or umbrella. There is NO shade on the beach area, so it’s easy to get too much sun during the hot Texas summer. Please keep canopies away from the water’s edge so people can watch their children. If you forget anything, we do have a fully-stocked store at the check-in office with sunblock, sun umbrellas, t-shirts, candy, ice cream, drinks, floaties,

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Our campsites range from wide-open spaces for tent communities to more isolated areas with a picnic table and fire ring to deep-woods primitive. Whatever your style, you’ll find the perfect spot within walking distance of the lake and one of the most beautiful sandy beaches in East Texas. All tent sites are 2 tents max per site with the exception of T8 and T9 which are group sites for 6+ tents. BY RESERVATION
